description: One charge the packer took off the top before paying. Packing, cold storage, marketing, commission — the four that show up on nearly every settlement — plus Other for the ones that do not. Kept as rows rather than as one netted-off number because the question a grower asks a year later is not 'what did I get' but 'what did storage cost me', and a single net figure cannot answer it.
